# Lattice open formats

> Public, agent-oriented index of Lattice workspace formats.
> Human docs: https://lattice-notes.com/docs/
> This pack: https://lattice-notes.com/open/

## Contracts

- CLI: /docs/cli-contract/
- MCP: /docs/mcp/
- HTTP API: /docs/api/
- Format support matrix: /docs/formats-support/
- Integrations: /docs/integrations/

## Open format layouts

- Workspace: /open/workspace/README.md
- Page (Markdown): /open/page/README.md
- Canvas (JSON Canvas): /open/canvas/README.md
- Data app (SQLite package): /open/data/README.md
- Dataset (Parquet): /open/dataset/README.md

- Docs project: /open/docs-project/README.md
- Pack index: /open/README.md

## Invariants for agents

1. A workspace is an ordinary directory; canonical content remains inspectable outside Lattice.
2. Prefer proposal-based writes through CLI, MCP, or HTTP API.
3. `.lattice/` holds caches and operational state — not the user's canonical documents.
4. Use the format support matrix for shipped vs near-roadmap honesty.
